author: NorthEast News Desk
body: The New Hampshire Department of Transportation is preparing to begin road work on the Everett Turnpike in Merrimack, WMUR reported Monday.

The announcement places the turnpike on the watch list for drivers traveling through one of southern New Hampshire’s busiest transportation corridors. The route carries local commuters, commercial traffic and travelers moving between the Merrimack area and other parts of the state.

WMUR’s initial report identified the upcoming work but did not provide every traffic-control detail in the information available for this article. Drivers should review the latest notices from N.H. DOT and follow posted lane instructions as the project begins.

Road projects on major turnpike routes can affect travel times beyond the immediate work zone, particularly during weekday commuting periods. Motorists who regularly use the Merrimack section may want to allow extra time and check for updated advisories before leaving.
NorthEast News will add verified schedule, lane-closure or completion information when it is released by transportation officials.
dek: Road work planned for the Everett Turnpike in Merrimack could affect commuters and commercial traffic using the southern New Hampshire corridor.
headline: N.H. DOT to begin road work on Everett Turnpike in Merrimack
